title: WHAT I GOTTA DO?
summary: A 2:45 music performance built around a heavily repeated “what I gotta do for you” refrain. Recoverable verse ideas ask how to show care, mention prom without hand-holding, absent love, ordering pizza and the addressee eating one slice, an unclear gift/object ignored in favor of fruit, trying to communicate through a single rose that is not smelled, a badly damaged relationship passage, giving “her” up, and a possible responding role asking what the other person must do. Long music gaps and corrupted captions prevent a complete verified lyric sheet. Every record and repetition remains in the raw/correction layer; the reader record uses concise navigation rather than inventing missing rhyme, names, plot, autobiography or voices. Zero named turns and enrollment windows ship.
